subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our annual Employee Appreciation Day is just around the corner! This year's event will be held on Friday, October 15th, from 2 PM to 6 PM at the company headquarters. There will be games, food, music, and raffle prizes to celebrate all your hard work and dedication. Please RSVP by October 8th so we can make proper arrangements. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
